audience: finance and support teams who take card payments with Checkout.com

useCases.title: Find a payment and read its history
useCases.text: The AI finds payments by reference, opens one payment and lists its actions (authorization, capture, refund, void). You see what happened, latest first.

useCases.title: Review payments from a period
useCases.text: The AI searches payments with query filters and summarizes the amounts and currencies. You get a short overview of the period.

useCases.title: Review open disputes and their deadlines
useCases.text: The AI lists disputes (chargebacks) with filters and opens each one for reason code, amount, deadline and evidence status. You get the ones to answer first.

useCases.title: Capture, refund or void a payment
useCases.text: After the AI checks the payment, it captures an authorized amount, refunds a captured payment in full or in part, or voids an authorization. Money moves, so confirm each step.

useCases.title: Create a payment link and check it
useCases.text: The AI creates a hosted Payment Link and gives you the URL to share with the customer. It can read the link's status later.

useCases.title: Find settlement and payment reports
useCases.text: The AI lists the reports on your account and opens one to read its metadata and downloadable files.
